goals.name: Improve dev workflows across my GitHub repos
goals.description: Reduce toil, increase velocity, or improve reliability across my active repos. Auto-executable when scoped to non-critical changes.

scoring_rubric.3: Video proposes a specific tool, config, or pattern I could adopt in <2h that plausibly saves >2h/week or catches a real class of bug.
scoring_rubric.2: Pattern requiring a spike (2-8h) with plausible payoff, or a small pattern with uncertain payoff.
scoring_rubric.1: Interesting concept, no concrete implementation path, or requires rework I don't currently need.
scoring_rubric.0: Not applicable ÔÇö content is about non-dev workflows.

goals.name: Small side income streams ($500-2k/mo, <10h/wk)
goals.description: Identify opportunities to generate modest recurring income. The goal is EXPLORATION ÔÇö surface new sectors, models, and niches beyond what I've already started. Do not filter to existing bets.

scoring_rubric.3: Concrete opportunity with a demonstrated revenue model in the video, testable in <10h, and a clear signal of demand. Sector irrelevant ÔÇö new sectors score just as high as familiar ones.
scoring_rubric.2: Adjacent opportunity or requires validation; economics plausible but not proven in the video.
scoring_rubric.1: Idea seed only; would need substantial validation before acting.
scoring_rubric.0: Not applicable, or fails the excludes list.

constraints.exploration_bonus: If the atom describes a sector I have not previously worked in, do NOT penalize relevance. Novelty is a feature of this goal.

goals.name: Self-maintaining business run by agents
goals.description: Patterns, architectures, and org models for businesses that agents operate autonomously. Includes but is not limited to ideas that inform MCPPay ÔÇö a video about a totally new agent-operated business in an unfamiliar sector is equally valid.

scoring_rubric.3: Concrete pattern, architecture, tool, or business model relevant to running a business with agents ÔÇö whether or not it connects to my existing work.
scoring_rubric.2: Transferable pattern that needs adaptation, or informs a longer- term design decision.
scoring_rubric.1: Interesting but abstract; no clear implementation path.
